author: New China TV
description:
Modern birds have short tails ending in a fused bone -- the pygostyle. Their dinosaur ancestors, by contrast, dragged long, reptilian tails. But how did the transition happen? 
Chinese researchers have recently discovered a new Jurassic bird fossil that could shed some light on the answer.
title: Newly discovered bird fossil sheds light on avian tail evolution mystery

description:

China's innovators are making cutting-edge AI affordable, practical, and surprisingly fun. #ChinaTech
title: I went to an AI market -- here's what I found!

author: New China TV
description:
This year marks the 105th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China (CPC). Xinhuanet presents "The Path to Success," a series of interviews with leaders from major political parties around the world to share their views on the CPC's governance practices and development experiences.
In this episode, Dmitry Novikov, deputy chairman of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation (CPRF), stated that the CPC has maintained enduring vitality and led the Chinese people to extraordinary achievements mainly because it unswervingly adheres to the fundamental principles of Marxism-Leninism while advancing with the times through innovative development, forging a vibrant path of socialist development that offers valuable reference for the international communist movement and political parties across the world.
title: CPC successfully forges vibrant development path: CPRF deputy chairman

author: New China TV
description:
What happens when a black maize variety from China meets the fields of Central Africa?
In demonstration plots in the Central African Republic, yields have doubled thanks to improved seed varieties and agricultural cooperation between the two countries.
From field trials to farmer training, the project is helping boost local food production and agricultural capacity.
title: GLOBALink | China-Africa agricultural cooperation helps double black maize yields
